The '''Mission to Fondor''' was undertaken in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], as well as Kenobi's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Prelude==
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the shipbuilder [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] conspired to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], and created a [[False Sun Runner|copy]] of the ancient [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', which he intended to crash into his target. When a [[Fondorian]] patrol ship disappeared after encountering the false ''Sun Runner'', the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], as well as Kenobi's apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], were tasked with investigating.<ref name="sunrunner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

==Mission==
Kenobi and Skywalker discovered that the ship was a fake&mdash;not the actual ''Sun Runner''&mdash;and, by planting a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] on the vessel's [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]] and demolishing its sensor-[[Guided missile/Legends|guided missile]] silo with the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion-missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launcher]] of a [[Rodd|borrowed]] [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], Skywalker was able to destroy it before it could complete its mission. In the process, the 18-year-old Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was forced to crash his [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|starfighter]] on the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]].<ref name="sunrunner" /> Kenobi and Swan followed his [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] to the [[Skull Queen's fortress|fortress]] of the moon's [[Skull Queen]]. The [[Queen/Legends|queen]] was also the moon's [[margravine]], [[Quenelle]], and [[Nallastian]] warriors had brought the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]]-[[Hondu Firewell|parents]] of the child [[Klay Firewell|Klay]] to her fortress to be [[Force field/Legends|force-field]] sacrificed between the [[Trinity Stones]], because Nallastia's [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Calvaria]] wrongfully accused the "[[outlander]]s" of violating their sacred law concerning the moon's wildlife. Skywalker, in turn, took Calvaria hostage in order to bargain for the release of Klay's parents, and Quenelle acquiesced. She and Kenobi set out to find the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]], which alone could dissipate the energy field that the captives were trapped in. Their hunt, which culminated in the [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]], was a success, but Kenobi called [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for backup, [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] that something wasn't right on nearby [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="screamingskulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>

Backup arrived in the form of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. When Groodo took over the [[Fondor Spaceport]], Windu, Fisto, Swan, and Quenelle liberated it. Groodo fled the [[Star system/Legends|system]], however, and the Jedi returned to Coruscant.<ref name="hostage princess">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan's]] comment to 18-year-old [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at the [[Skull Queen]]'s [[Skull Queen's fortress|fortress]] that ''"Jedi don't have nightmares"''<ref name="hostage princess" /> serves as a precursor reference to Anakin's identical line of dialogue with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] as he stands on the east balcony of the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family's]] [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] lodge (in both ''Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones'' [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novel]] and [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|screenplay]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>) that appears to directly quote Swan from Skywalker's [[Skull Queen's fortress#Disturbing dreams|memory]] of their [[Skull Queen's fortress#No nightmares|discussion]] about '[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dream/Legends|dreams]]' during their mission to Fondor some months earlier.
